rules.title: Eldera Online 15 server profile
rules.summary: Eldera Online 15 runs the Canary 15 stack with PvP enabled, protection level 7, and baseline rates set to 1x for experience, skill, magic, loot, and spawn.

rules.title: Copilot Phase 2 policy
rules.summary: Copilot is read-only in this phase. Gemini, route execution, tasker, and direct gameplay actions are disabled while the curated KB contract is stabilized.
